title: Concept set
description: At least three genuinely different ways to make this video. Generating one storyboard straight from inspection produces the same film every time; the point of a set is that they should be hard to choose between.

premise.description: What the viewer watches happen. A description of the film, not of the product.

central_metaphor.description: The one idea every scene serves. "Context is a baton" is a metaphor; "it is fast and reliable" is not.

visual_rule.description: The constraint that decides every later question. Strong enough that violating it would be obvious.

emotional_arc.description: Where the viewer starts and where they end, e.g. fragmentation to continuity.

forbidden_motifs.description: What this concept must never become. Usually the generic version of itself — the thing it would drift into under pressure.

suggested_world.description: A visual world id, if one obviously fits. The director may override it.

beats.description: Rough shape only. The scene graph is built later, from the concept that wins.

why_this_product.description: Why this concept could not be reused for a different product. If it could, it is a template.

risk.description: The most likely way this concept fails in execution.
